id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

nativeToolDocumentationOverride.description:
The default tool description will be derived from the python signature and docstring for
the function returned by {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.FunctionCalling#pyFuncForAgent}. If provided, values in this
dictionary will override those from the generated description.

* name: The name of the tool/function
* description: A brief description of the tool/function (normally derived from the docstring)
* parameters: A dict of (parameter name, python type string) pairs
             (e.g. {"currency": {"type": "str"}, "value": {"type": "float"}})
* return_type: The python type string of the return value (e.g. "dict")

NOTE: due to issues with serializing the 'type' key, you may set nativeToolDocumentationOverride to a JSON string
representation (or json.dumps from python) of the dictionary instead of the dictionary itself.

serializeInputsForFunctionCall.description:
If true, the {@link Genai.Agent.Planner} will serialize inputs for the function call.
Otherwise, the in-memory references will be passed.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

finalAnswerPrompt.description: The prompt to use for generating the final answer
